mission.text: Independent recovery plus real consumer validation remains the primary PRIMER mission. Engineering branches may progress without replacing that mission.
mission.next_valid_action: Run a fresh critical-state recovery with consumer verification and quantify recoverable data loss; keep device-two/full-disaster acceptance separate.

verification.detail: Bounded candidate changes may be verified in isolated branches.
Exact-head CI/test evidence is tracked per PR; do not generalize across heads.
Must prove a real consumer can use the recovered or changed state.
Same-device recovery is not device-two or full-disaster recovery.
VIRA/VAKIL acceptance must be separately evidenced.

gates.detail: No merge/deploy from shadow evidence alone.
Independent review must target the current exact SHA.
Requires explicit device access and scope.

reviews.detail: Internal review found missing positive live-agent path test; PR remains draft.

evidence.detail: Operational Solution Engine skill added without write-capable tools.
Read-only shadow surface; publication not claimed.
